chunks: Muhammad ibn Hakim narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying regarding a woman who has despaired of menstruation, whose husband divorces her: He said, "She is separated from him, and there is no waiting period upon her."

key_terms.بَانَتْ: she is separated and no longer remains in the marital bond
key_terms.عِدَّةَ: the waiting period required after divorce in certain cases
key_terms.يَئِسَتْ: has despaired, meaning she has reached menopause and no longer expects menstruation

ai.seo_question: Does a menopausal woman have to observe an 'iddah after divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a woman who has reached menopause and is divorced by her husband. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that the divorce takes effect and that no 'iddah is required for her.
